title: One pot access to 2-iodo-2-deoxy nucleosides directly from glycals and unprotected nucleobases and their biological evaluation on the Japanese Encephalitis Virus
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26490-26496
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02382C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Norein Sakander, Km. Archana, Ajaz Ahmed, Shriyanshi Mishra, Raj Kamal Tripathi, Debaraj Mukherjee
An expedient one-pot stereo- and regioselective synthesis of 2-iodo-nucleosides from protected glycals and nucleobases using easily available iodine and hexamethyldisilane has been developed, and their application against Japanese Encephalitis Virus found.
